hero.title: I *build* products that *live* at the edge of *web*, *mobile*, and *AI*

about.intro: A developer who builds *real-world products* and solves problems that actually *matter*.
about.description: A *full stack and mobile-first* mindset — comfortable across frontend, backend, and AI integration, with a habit of **learning through building** and a commitment to ***clean, scalable code***.
about.full:
I am a B.Tech Information Technology student graduating in 2026, based in Tamil Nadu, India. My approach to software development has always been project-first — I learn best when I am building something real that solves an actual problem.

On the frontend, I work primarily with React and Next.js, using TypeScript for reliability and Tailwind CSS to move fast without losing quality. For mobile, I build production-grade apps with React Native and Expo — cross-platform, performant, and user-friendly.

My backend work centres around Node.js and Express.js, designing RESTful APIs that are clean, versioned, and maintainable. I use MongoDB and Firebase for flexible data needs, and MySQL when structured schemas are a better fit.

One area I'm deeply invested in is AI integration — not in a hype-driven way, but practically. I've built offline AI applications using local LLMs (via Ollama), speech-to-text with Whisper, and RAG-based document Q&A systems. My goal is always to make AI useful in real workflows, especially in resource-constrained environments.

I care about the architecture behind what I build. A working product that is unmaintainable is a failure. I prefer to take the time to understand the problem deeply before writing code, and I hold a high bar for readability and consistency in everything I ship.

I am actively looking for Full Stack, React Native, or AI-related internships and job opportunities where I can contribute meaningfully from day one.

projects.intro: Real-world *applications* built across *web*, *mobile*, and *AI* — each one solving a problem worth solving.

items.title: Transcriber AI
items.description: An offline-first AI transcription and analysis app built with React Native. Records live audio, transcribes speech in real time, generates structured meeting summaries, and provides searchable transcript history — all without an internet connection.

items.title: Mahendra R&D Hub
items.description: A full-stack facility management platform built for a research institution — featuring a public access portal, real-time admin dashboard, booking and approval workflows, and a resource inventory system with availability constraints.

items.title: E-Commerce Mobile App
items.description: A production-ready React Native e-commerce application with WooCommerce integration, real-time product search, multi-brand architecture, cart management, secure checkout, and full order tracking — built for scale.

items.title: Lecture AI
items.description: An AI-powered lecture summarization and analysis app built with React Native. Records live audio, transcribes speech in real time, generates structured meeting summaries, and provides searchable transcript history.

items.title: Smart Attendance System
items.description: A comprehensive attendance management system built for Educational Institutions - featuring robust authentication, automated attendance marking, detailed reporting, and intuitive classroom management tools.

roadmap.description: A timeline of learning milestones — from first principles to full-stack and AI development.

items.description: Started my programming journey by studying the fundamentals — algorithms, logic, and problem-solving. Learned how to think like a developer before writing a single line of production code.
Built my first web projects using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Learned how the browser works, how the DOM behaves, and how to take a design from concept to a working interface.
Moved into full stack development — React on the frontend, Node.js and Express on the backend, MongoDB for data. Built my first complete web application: a College Inventory Management System.
Expanded into mobile with React Native and Expo. Shipped an e-commerce app with WooCommerce integration. Started exploring AI-powered applications using local LLMs, Whisper, and RAG architectures.

Focused on production-grade software — performance, architecture, and reliability. Deepening expertise in AI integration, enterprise-scale React Native apps, and system design as I prepare to graduate and enter the industry.

contact.description: Open to full stack, React Native, and AI-related internships or full-time roles. Let's build something that matters.
